I added a 0.25s sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`. The limit is 5 requests per second, so calls need to be at least 0.2s apart; 0.25s leaves a bit of room. The value is a named constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL_S`, with a comment explaining the rate limit. This adds about 1s to the test.

I haven't run the test. It's an integration test that calls the external sandbox, so I can't show the flake is fixed. The real check will be whether CI stops flaking.

I also saved the 5 requests/second limit to project memory, so future tests that call the sandbox will take it into account.
